page: Microsoft Azure E8-2ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadsv7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture using AMD processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not feature any graphics processing units, with a GPU count of 0.0. The instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the E8-2ads_v7 provides a high density of memory relative to its compute allocation, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require high CPU core counts. Tradeoffs include a lower compute capacity due to the 2 vCPU limit. This hardware profile is suited for relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics tasks requiring substantial memory capacity but moderate processing power.
